summary: Healthcare Triangle, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a Securities Exchange Agreement with SecureKloud Technologies Ltd. on June 24, 2026. The Company will issue 2,828,167 common shares to SecureKloud (or its nominee) as a make-whole in exchange for the return of all Series B Preferred Stock previously issued under an earlier Asset Transfer Agreement. The exchange settles amounts owed by SecureKloud and is subject to stockholder approval per Nasdaq Rule 5635(b). No price per share or valuation is stated. The filing also includes an Amendment No. 1 to a Share Purchase Agreement with Teyame AI Holdings Inc. The transaction is structured as a settlement of prior asset-purchase consideration. Watch for stockholder vote and regulatory compliance.
